name: syn_loan_summary
description: Summary of a commercial mortgage loan from a loan summary or term sheet. One entry per document. Dates in YYYY-MM-DD. Money as plain numbers. Where the document does not state something, the value is null.

lender_name.name: Lender
lender_name.description: Full legal name of the lender exactly as written.

borrower_name.name: Borrower
borrower_name.description: Full legal name of the borrower exactly as written, including the entity suffix.

property_address.name: Property Address
property_address.description: Street address of the mortgaged property, including city, state and ZIP where given.

loan_amount.name: Loan Amount
loan_amount.description: Original principal amount of the loan, as a number.

interest_rate_pct.name: Interest Rate
interest_rate_pct.description: Annual fixed interest rate as a percentage number exactly as printed (6.5 for 6.5%).

closing_date.name: Closing Date
closing_date.description: The date the loan closed or was funded.

maturity_date.name: Maturity Date
maturity_date.description: The date the loan matures and all principal is due.

loan_term_months.name: Loan Term (months)
loan_term_months.description: Length of the loan term in whole months. Compute it from the dates if not stated.

amortization_years.name: Amortization (years)
amortization_years.description: Amortization period in years, as a number.

monthly_payment.name: Monthly Payment
monthly_payment.description: Scheduled monthly payment of principal and interest, as a number.

annual_debt_service.name: Yearly Loan Payments
annual_debt_service.description: Total scheduled principal and interest payments for one year, as a number. Compute it as the monthly payment times 12 if not stated.

guarantor_name.name: Guarantor
guarantor_name.description: Full name of any guarantor of the loan. null if no guarantor is named.
